title: refactor(ci): modernize lint/test/release workflows and bump GH Actions/deps
author: Evelyn Park
description: Motivation: our mono-repo CI has accumulated multiple overlapping workflows for lint/test/release over the past 18 months. This results in duplicated steps, inconsistent Node/Action versions, and slow CI (cache misses + serial matrix runs). This PR consolidates lint/test/release workflows into shared templates, upgrades GH Actions and official actions to current stable versions, standardizes Node.js to 20 across workflows, improves cache key hygiene, and optimizes job parallelism and matrix partitioning. Summary of changes: - Replace duplicated .github/workflows/* files with two shared workflow templates: .github/workflows/ci-lint-test.yml (lint + unit/integration partitioned matrix) and .github/workflows/release.yml (release automation / tagger) - Migrate reusable workflow templates to .github/workflows/workflows-templates/ for reuse across subrepos - Bump frequently-used actions to recommended tags (actions/checkout@v4, actions/setup-node@v4, actions/cache@v4) - Standardize node-version: 20.x across CI and tests (aligns with dev environment) - Improve cache keys: include package-lock/hash + node-version + platform to reduce cross-platform cache misses - Consolidate linting steps into a single job using the monorepo lint script; add fast-fail where appropriate - Optimize test matrix: split by package group + test type to reduce overall queue time and increase cachability - Add selective integration-e2e gating on release branch (keep expensive e2e runs off PRs unless label added) - Replace release workflow to use release-please + semantic-release steps with better artifact tagging and changelog generation - Remove legacy workflows: old node12/14 compatibility jobs and redundant nightly cron jobs (kept as archived comments for reference) - Update CONTRIBUTING.md and docs/ci.md with new CI runbook and troubleshooting tips Checklist: - [x] Consolidate workflows and templates - [x] Bump GH actions and standardize Node 20 - [x] Improve cache keys and parallelism - [x] Run full CI on redwood repo and validate flaky tests - [x] Update docs and contributor guidance Testing done: - Ran full CI matrix on this branch (2x reruns for flaky suites) - Verified cache warm hits for repeated runs - Confirmed release workflow runs on release-preview tag in staging - Smoke-tested important SDK build artifacts (python wheel, npm packages) Rollback plan: revert the merge commit; legacy workflows are retained in the branch until two weeks after rollout to allow quick restore. Notes: This PR intentionally does not change runtime code; it's CI infra only. If you maintain a sub-repo that needs a custom matrix, add a small YAML file that references the reusable templates rather than forking steps. Related: ENG-4822 (CI modernization), ENG-4824 (reduce CI costs).
